title: PCAN-PIE machine-learning tool prioritizes prodrug candidates by predicted bioactivation
summary: PCAN-PIE, a paired-input ensemble model, distinguishes prodrug candidates likely to release their intended active drug from those unlikely to activate. In a prospective four-candidate campaign, the two prioritized candidates showed measurable API formation and cellular activity while the two deprioritized showed negligible conversion and activity. The date is that of the ChemRxiv v3 record (earlier versions not checked), only four candidates were tested and benchmark metrics are not in the abstract.
ai_technology: PCAN-PIE paired-input ensemble machine-learning model predicting prodrug bioactivation

evidence.tested: Four candidates were prioritized or deprioritized by the model and then tested for API formation and cellular activity.
evidence.unknown: Benchmark metrics; hit rate beyond four candidates; dates of earlier preprint versions; full text not reviewed.
